dashboard.label: SOC Playground — Attack Detection Dashboard
dashboard.description: Real SPL detections for the simulated pseudo-attack techniques. Proof of ingestion and detection in one view.

panel.title: Attk101 — SSH Brute Force (Linux auth.log) — top source IPs

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" earliest=-48h@h latest=@h | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "from\s+(?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | stats count by src_ip | sort - count | head 10

panel.title: Ingestion over fixed window by sourcetype

search.query: index=soc_capstone earliest=-48h@h latest=@h | stats count by sourcetype | sort - count

panel.title: Attk101 — SSH failed logins by source IP (Kali)

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password" earliest=-48h@h latest=@h | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "from\s+(?<src_ip>\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)" | stats count by host, src_ip | sort - count | head 20

index=soc_capstone sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational "EventID>3<" earliest=-48h@h latest=@h | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "SourceIp.\>(?<src_ip>[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "DestinationIp.\>(?<dest_ip>[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "DestinationPort.\>(?<dest_port>[0-9]+)" | stats count by host, src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port | sort - count | head 20

panel.title: Attk102 — Local Account Creation (Security 4720) + Admin group adds

search.query: index=soc_capstone sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security (EventCode=4720 OR EventCode=4728 OR EventCode=4732) earliest=-48h@h latest=@h | eval action=case(EventCode=="4720","ACCOUNT_CREATED", EventCode=="4728","ADDED_TO_LOCALGROUP", EventCode=="4732","ADDED_TO_GLOBALGROUP") | eval actor=mvindex(Account_Name,0) | eval target=mvindex(Account_Name,1) | eval target=if(target=="-" OR isnull(target),"N/A",target) | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "Group Name:\s+(?<group_name>[^\r\n]+)" | table _time, host, action, actor, target, group_name | sort - _time
index=soc_capstone DownloadString earliest=-48h@h latest=@h | stats count by host, sourcetype | sort - count

index=soc_capstone sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational "EventID>3<" powershell.exe earliest=-48h@h latest=@h | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "SourceIp.\>(?<src_ip>[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "DestinationIp.\>(?<dest_ip>[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)" | rex field=_raw max_match=1 "DestinationPort.\>(?<dest_port>[0-9]+)" | stats count by host, src_ip, dest_ip, dest_port | sort - count | head 20

index=soc_capstone ((sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=1102) OR (sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational "EventID>4<")) earliest=-48h@h latest=@h | table _time host | sort - _time
